items.label: Protect the market crowd
items.summary: Make space around the driverless tax wagon, steady frightened people and animals, or organize practical help before panic chooses the story.

items.label: Inspect the tax wagon
items.summary: Examine the wet canvas, dry cargo, harness, wheels, driver’s bench, and anything that suggests where the wagon was changed or abandoned.

items.label: Question the witnesses
items.summary: Compare what traders, watch officers, children, dockworkers, and performers heard or saw without assuming their contradictions are lies.

items.label: Study the thirteenth stroke
items.summary: Listen for civic, theatrical, and river-working patterns in the bell intervals, or find someone who knows how Bramblebridge normally marks noon.

items.label: Follow an immediate lead
items.summary: Choose the tower, river, market records, horse, cargo trail, or departing witnesses; the investigation does not require a single prescribed route.

items.label: Consult Rain at Noon
items.summary: Use the stored Session 1 preparation, redundant clue paths, NPC voices, failure-forward pressure, and onion-broth closing beat without deciding player actions.

items.label: Preserve clue separation
items.summary: Reveal only evidence actually established in play; keep the dry flour, theatre fibres, and river timing as distinct discoverable clues.
